definitions: The destruction of a ship or other vessel at sea.
A ship or other vessel that has been destroyed at sea.
A person who is in a very bad physical or mental condition.
A car, aeroplane, or other vehicle that has been very badly damaged in an accident.
examples: The wreck of the Titanic lies deep in the Atlantic.
After the party, he was an absolute wreck.
They cleared the wreck from the motorway.
The storm caused a number of wrecks along the coast.
